name: r2 fold-back W1.0 D1.5
purpose: Board r2 (AirTag.kicad_pcb of 2026-11-14 14:30: 24 x 20 mm, F.Cu GND pour only, AE1 at (146, 97), feed routed from L1). With the feed at x 146 a straight arm ends at A 13 (L 18.4 mm, about 21.5 needed). New family fmifa: the arm folds back towards the feed on a lower row instead of meandering down towards the ground (less copper near the ground). Return length R tuned so the S11 minimum sits at 2.460 GHz. Variant: 1 mm traces, return row 0.5 mm below the arm.
